siDisclosure.policy: NASA Space Apps Challenge Use of Super Intelligence (SI) Compliance
siDisclosure.codeAndData: SI coding assistants were used to assist in TypeScript/React UI implementation, Python raster preparation scripts, and automated test suites. Runtime route optimization (src/domain/jezeroRouteMlModel.json) uses a local 27-tree CART Random Forest + Ridge Regression ensemble trained on NASA Mars 2020 DEM, HiRISE/CTX, and THEMIS rasters.
siDisclosure.imagesAndVideos: All planetary maps, DEMs, and rover surface frames are authentic NASA/JPL-Caltech/USGS/ASU/MSSS archival datasets. XAI diagnostic charts in docs/xai/ include visible SI/ML-assisted watermarks.
siDisclosure.nasaBranding: Contains no NASA logos, flags, insignia, or modified branding elements.
